Create the project board and plan Sprint 1

## Goal

Set up the board your team will work from, then plan the first sprint.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A GitHub Project is linked to this repo, with the columns Backlog, Ready, In Progress, In Review, and Done.
- [ ] All issues labeled `sprint-0` are on the board.
- [ ] The board has 6–12 new Sprint 1 issues for the navigation skeleton and core screens. These starter issues don't count toward that number.
- [ ] Each Sprint 1 issue has acceptance criteria, an owner, and a label.
- [ ] A Sprint 1 milestone, due November 17, has those issues attached.
- [ ] The backlog holds the rest of the MVP.

## Where to look

Canvas: [Team] GitHub Repository & Project Board Setup and Introduction to GitHub Projects and Issue Templates.
